palette.name: Guidance Green
palette.usage: Headlines, growth figures, anything above last quarter.
palette.label: positive
palette.example: Net revenue increased 18% compared to the prior year, driven by strong demand for our core products.

palette.name: Cautious Optimism Blue
palette.usage: Body copy, risk factors, forward-looking statements.
palette.label: neutral
palette.example: A significant portion of our revenue is derived from a limited number of customers.

palette.name: Write-Down Red
palette.usage: Reserved for competitors. Use sparingly, at 8pt or smaller.
palette.label: negative
palette.example: Operating income declined primarily due to higher input costs.
